notes: «قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» gives the manner of hearing, not a link
Malik, Yunus and Amr b. al-Harith share one level before «أن ابن شهاب، أخبرهم» (rule 2 and 5)
«قال أبو عبد الرحمن لم يذكر مالك عروة» is the compiler's remark on another version (Malik without Urwa); it names no route and is left out
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
«أنه سمع أباه» makes the father the last link: the saying is his
